stimulus: Attain the pinned initial WAL transition cuts after the cold header, after the synced header and after the first main-page write. Capture main and journal identity and bytes before opening the original SQLite file.

Repeat the exact original CreateStore through the owning subject. Witness raw classification, bounded SQLite recovery and same-inode empty outcome, then the original creation group and independent export.

In a disposable previously initialized store keep matching creation/allocation records and inodes, drift offline to legacy journal mode, and interrupt a real database update after its hot journal and main write. Check the rejected original without an early SQLite open.

The initialized hot-journal and mismatched originals receive zero SQLite opens and keep their original bytes and identities. The observer supplies no original SQLite open before the subject recovery witness.
